TITLE: Subway Wall Poem in Permanent Marker
TEXT:
i came down here
because the surface was too loud

the tracks hum
like a long thought

someone wrote LOVE
then crossed it out
then wrote it again
bigger

i am learning:
what survives
is what you repeat
with your whole hand

if you see this
and you are lonely
blink twice at the tunnel

we are all waiting
for something that arrives
and also
for something that doesn't
